what_happened: The job to add a diagnose-failure skill and load it into introspection was rejected at the final verdict. One of 6 acceptance criteria was unmet: the one requiring cargo test, clippy and fmt to be clean. There was one major finding: cargo fmt --check fails on the new constant at crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs:1029. One check failed, fmt. The failed check and the unmet criterion are different things; the criterion was unmet because the fmt check was red. The other five criteria were met.
cause: Formatting is a mechanical, auto-fixable property, but nothing in the producer's flow applies the formatter or runs the fmt check before it declares the work done. The failure surfaces only at the end, where it counts against a broad "all checks clean" criterion and rejects the whole job. A rejection is the wrong outcome for a defect a tool can repair with no judgment. The new multi-line constant, probably a long prompt string, is the sort of edit that trips rustfmt.
prevention: Add a code step that runs cargo fmt on the producer's working copy after it finishes, and then runs cargo fmt --check. Only a failure that survives the formatter would reach the verifier. This makes formatting failures impossible for the whole class. No gate is relaxed: every gate has 0 disagreements, including fmt with 2 ends.
proposed_request: Make Athena run `cargo fmt` automatically on the producer's working copy after the producer stage finishes and before the checks and the verifier, so that a formatting-only difference never causes a rejection. Outcome: a job whose only defect is rustfmt layout (for example a long constant in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs) reaches the verifier already formatted and is judged on its work. Acceptance: (1) after the producer stage, the formatter is applied and the fmt check is run on the result; (2) a test builds a working copy with a mis-formatted file and shows the file is reformatted and the fmt check passes; (3) a real fmt failure that the formatter cannot fix still fails the job and is shown in the failed-check output; (4) the recorded diff includes the formatter's changes; (5) cargo test, clippy --all-targets -D warnings and fmt --check pass on the workspace.
